name: check_repair_status
description: Look up the status of a car that is already at the shop. Requires the customer's last name AND either the phone number on the ticket or the RO (repair order) number. Ask for both before calling. If found=false with 'needs', ask for what's missing; if it can't verify, offer to take a message.

last_name.description: Customer last name as on the repair order

phone.description: Phone number on the repair order, digits only
